name: Kasumi Kentarou
source:
A 32 years old who works in the sales division for a major sports manufacturer.

He was a promising track and field athlete who even placed in the Inter-High School Championships, but his dreams were cut short due to injury.

He harbors a latent complex about being expected to do well.
